rows.coder_note: The abstract names the UK Biobank as the cohort of a nested case-cohort design and mentions GWAS without saying which outcome GWAS was used; 706 RA patients and 1410 controls describe the Cox proteomic analysis, not a GWAS release, so no release or defined own GWAS is identified (rules C, D).
The abstract names 'the UKB-PPP dataset' only, with no subcohort, ancestry, sample size or citation; the name alone does not separate the four dictionary rows (rule D).
